content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on a project where a pump needs to be switched on and off continuously. I used an edge-triggered relay function with TH set to 10 minutes and TL set to 5 minutes. However, the current setup only permits a maximum of 9 cycles. Is there a way to make this run indefinitely?
You can use the asynchronous pulse generator to achieve unlimited cycles.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces a limit with the edge-triggered relay function, which only supports up to 9 cycles for the pump's on/off operation. This prevents setting up a truly continuous automated process, impacting scenarios where infinite cyclic operation is required.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the control logic to provide unlimited cycling of the pump, enabling the process to operate continuously without requiring manual resets or workaround programming.
